name: 希波诺
src: 月银纪史诗/第十一歌_天马落羽.md:186
who: Hipono, a human prince and horseman of the steppe, twenty-one, in the days before he was blinded: about 178 cm, lean, a rider's narrow frame, straight-backed. Long pale-gold hair tied behind his head with a cord of braided horse mane. His eyes are OPEN and amber, narrowed as if judging how far a horse can run; he is NOT blindfolded here, and his hair is pure pale gold with NO white in it, which is how this younger version differs from the older blind man in the attached picture. A handsome face with a narrow jaw, fair skin lightly warmed by the sun, a calm face that sometimes shows a boy's pride. A broken bowstring is wound round his left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us). A quiet, proud, fast air.
build: 178 cm, lean and long-limbed: a rider's narrow frame and strong legs.
palette: pale gold and amber, pasture green, leather brown, white-ash wood, a little bronze
casual: A steppe rider's clothes: a short slit-sided tunic with a plain round neckline that closes straight down the middle of the chest with a few small bone buttons, NOT a wrapped or crossed-over diagonal front, over close trousers, leather leg guards, soft boots, a broken bowstring wrapped round his left wrist; a sealed letter tied at his belt. In his right hand he holds a long lance with a white-ash shaft and a bronze head, point up, the butt on the ground. He stands with the weight on one leg, looking into the distance, no bow anywhere.
private: A loose undyed long-sleeved linen shirt, soft trousers and house boots, the pale hair let down loose, the broken bowstring still at his wrist; arms folded. A quiet, faraway look.
battle: Ready to charge: a light steppe armour of leather scales with a running horse burned into the plates, the horse-mane cord tying his hair, leather bracers; he holds the bronze-headed lance low and forward in both hands, knees bent, no bow. A hard, focused look, mouth closed.
formal: As a guest-prince at a royal hall, dressed as a steppe rider: a belted felt riding tunic with side vents and a plain round neckline, close trousers, leather leg guards and soft boots, a short cloak fastened with a cast bronze brooch in the shape of a running horse, a braided horse-mane cord round the waist. The sealed letter hangs at his belt and the bronze-headed lance stands upright in his right hand; a faint amber glint of core-light shows in the brooch. He stands very correctly, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the amber eyes open and looking far past the viewer, a faint proud tilt of the chin. Warm low sun from one side, pale sky behind. Foreground blur: drifting white feathers and grass seed. He wears the steppe riding tunic, no blindfold, the broken bowstring on his wrist.

name: 洛温
src: 月银纪史诗/第十一歌_天马落羽.md:242
who: Rowen, a human princess of the mountain kingdom of the Antler Peak and the keeper of its register of names, nineteen: about 168 cm, upright and quick-stepping. Long flaxen hair in two plaits coiled at the back of the head, a few short strands falling over the forehead. Winter-lake blue eyes that do not look away, thin straight brows, a delicate clear face, a tiny mole at the back of her neck. A charcoal pencil is tucked in her sleeve. A clear, steady, dutiful air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a delicate clear young woman's face of about nineteen, thin straight brows, winter-lake blue eyes that hold the viewer's gaze, a firm small mouth; skin shadows a soft pink-orange.
build: 168 cm, upright and slender: straight shoulders, a small bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep blue and white, flaxen, thunder-hide grey, wood brown
casual: A deep blue Antler Peak cloak embroidered with a pair of white antlers, over a short dark blue wool riding skirt with leggings and soft boots; a small round shield covered in thunder-hide on her left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us), a short sword with a dry wooden grip and a dark glazed ceramic blade in her right hand held point down, no iron anywhere on her; a charcoal pencil in her sleeve. She stands upright, a steady, direct look.
private: A soft long-sleeved dress of undyed wool with a grey knitted shawl, the plaits let down over one shoulder, soft shoes, the charcoal pencil still in her sleeve; she holds a closed book against her chest. A gentle, thoughtful look.
battle: Ready on the gate tower: the blue antler cloak thrown back, a leather jerkin and quilted skirt over leggings, leather bracers, a glazed ceramic helmet; the thunder-hide round shield raised on her left arm, the ceramic-bladed short sword with a dry wooden grip held forward in her right hand, no iron. A resolute look, mouth closed.
formal: For a court rite of the five kingdoms: a long deep blue wool gown with long sleeves and the white antler embroidery along the hem, the antler cloak clasped at the shoulder, the plaits coiled and pinned with a white bone comb, a thin silver chain. She stands very upright with hands folded in front, a grave, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the winter-lake blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, lips closed. Cold white daylight from one side, a warm torch glow behind. Foreground blur: a hand-written page of names, a charcoal stick and drifting snowflakes. She wears the blue antler cloak.

name: 苔丝
src: 月银纪史诗/第十一歌_天马落羽.md:299
who: Tess, a female dwarf of the pumice-gorge clan, a rope-bridge mender, sixty years old but looking early twenties as dwarves do: about 138 cm, small, strong-armed and broad-handed. Copper-red hair done in a dozen thin braids with polished pumice beads threaded at the ends that click when she moves. A round face with freckles over the nose and cheeks, big bright green eyes, dimples when she smiles. Rope calluses on her knuckles. A small pendant of pumice hangs at her neck on a cord, so light it lifts a little. A cheerful, fearless, noisy air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's face of about twenty-two, round, with freckles across the nose and cheeks, big bright green eyes, dimples; skin shadows a warm pink-orange. NOT a child.
build: 138 cm, small and sturdy: strong arms, a C-cup, a firm waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: copper red and bright green, canvas cream, pumice grey, rope brown
casual: Thick canvas work clothes: a short jacket and trousers tied tight at the ankles, a belt hung with hooks, wedges and a small hammer, a coil of pumice-fibre rope over one shoulder and across the body, worn leather gloves, the pumice pendant at her neck, sturdy boots. She stands with one hand on the rope coil and the other on the hammer, a cheeky grin.
private: A soft undyed wool sweater to mid-thigh over short leggings, thick knitted socks, the braids loose with their beads, the pumice pendant at her neck; she stands with her hands tucked in the sleeves. A sleepy grin.
battle: Ready on a swinging bridge: the canvas jacket buttoned and belted tight, leather knee and elbow pads, thick gloves; the small hammer gripped in her right hand, a loop of rope in her left, feet planted wide, the braids tied back. A fierce, fearless look.
formal: For a gorge festival: a clean dark green wool dress with a wide belt and short puffed sleeves over a white blouse, the braids pinned up with the pumice beads gleaming, the pumice pendant outside, polished boots. She stands straight and proud, a bright dimpled smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the green eyes bright, a laughing grin with dimples. Warm sun from one side, a deep blue gorge sky behind. Foreground blur: a strand of rope and drifting pale pumice dust. She wears the canvas jacket.

name: 汐拉
src: 月银纪史诗/第十一歌_天马落羽.md:355
who: Sheila, a sea-kin diving fisher girl of the southern coast, twenty-two: about 165 cm, slender, with an even shoulder line. Sea-green hair, wet-looking, falling to her waist with curled ends. Two fine gill lines on each side of her neck that flutter in damp air. Deep-sea blue eyes that make you feel you could sink into them. Pale skin with a faint sea-blue tint, salt crystals clinging to her lashes and glinting. A quiet, dreamy, steady air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a calm young woman's face of about twenty-two, deep-sea blue eyes, salt crystals on the lashes, fine gill lines on the neck; skin shadows a cool pale blue-pink.
build: 165 cm, slender and long-limbed: even shoulders and back, a D-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: sea green and deep blue, lead grey, salt white, bone
casual: A sleeveless fisher tunic of grey-blue cloth to mid-thigh over short wrapped trousers, a row of small lead weights sewn round the hem, bare feet; a bone knife at her belt, a coil of fine net over one forearm, a pierced lead disc on a cord at her neck. She stands with a calm, distant look.
private: A loose long-sleeved pale blue linen dress to the shins, a knitted grey shawl, bare feet, the sea-green hair loose; the pierced lead disc at her neck. A soft, dreamy look.
battle: Ready to dive in a fight: the lead-hemmed tunic belted tight, leather wrist guards, wrapped trousers; the bone knife gripped low in her right hand, the net held open in her left, knees bent, the wet hair tied back. A cold, alert look, mouth closed.
formal: For a coastal rite: a long layered gown of sea-green and white sheer linen with long flowing sleeves, strings of small white shells along the neckline, the hair pinned up with a shell comb, the lead disc worn on a silver chain. She stands very upright, hands folded in front, a serene look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the deep blue eyes looking at the viewer, salt crystals glinting on the lashes, lips closed. Cool bright light from the water surface above one side. Foreground blur: drifting bubbles and floating salt glitter. She wears the lead-hemmed tunic.

name: 洛蔓
src: 月银纪史诗/第十一歌_天马落羽.md:558
who: Roman, queen of the Deer Gate kingdom and eldest daughter of the king of the Antler Peak, twenty-five: tall and slender, about 170 cm. Long flaxen hair worn loose and straight like her sister's, eyes the grey of a lake before rain. A strikingly beautiful soft face, the more beautiful when she weeps; she speaks softly. A gentle, wounded, guarded air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strikingly beautiful soft young woman's face of about twenty-five, grey rain-lake eyes, delicate brows, a soft mouth; skin shadows a soft pink-orange.
build: 170 cm, tall and slender: soft shoulders, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: flaxen and rain grey, pale rose, deep blue, silver
casual: A queen's everyday dress of the Deer Gate: a long soft pale-rose wool gown with long sleeves, a deep blue belt, a short shawl pinned with a small silver deer-antler brooch, soft shoes; the flaxen hair loose down her back. She stands with her hands clasped before her, a soft, sad look.
private: A plain long-sleeved undyed wool dress, a knitted grey shawl, the hair in a loose braid over one shoulder, soft shoes; arms folded across herself. A quiet, downcast look.
battle: Defiant, no weapon: the pale-rose gown with a deep blue cloak clasped over it, silver antler brooch, leather belt; she stands tall with her chin up and one hand pressed flat to her chest, the other held out palm up. A proud, tearful look.
formal: For a royal feast: a long deep blue velvet gown with long sleeves and a wide neck, a silver band set with small antlers on her brow, a silver chain, the flaxen hair half pinned and half loose. She stands very gracefully with hands folded in front, a composed, lovely look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the face large, rain-grey eyes glistening and looking at the viewer, lips softly closed. Cool pale light from one side, warm candlelight behind. Foreground blur: out-of-focus candle flames and drifting petals. She wears the pale-rose gown.
